capabilities: add tags to new notes based on folder rules
swap folder tags when a note is moved between folders
manage folder rules from settings or the file explorer context menu
apply rules to all existing notes on demand
tag or rename new notes with a creation-time stamp
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; installable via BRAT or manually from releases. Needs Obsidian 1.13 or newer (older versions get 1.1.1). Rules are stored in the vault's .obsidian folder and share across devices only when devices open the same vault folder. Tags written in the managed block are overwritten, and synced-in files are not treated as new.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically add or update a note's tags when it is created in or moved to a different folder, so tags must be maintained by hand.

relations.evidence: Templater templates work too, including ones that ask you something before they fill the note.
Excalidraw drawings and Kanban boards are always left alone.

summary: Folder-based auto-tagging plugin that adds tags to notes when they are created in or moved into folders matching configured rules.
